gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Wide-set, swooping geometry from Redux, with big entry strokes into every curve. Noto Sans Saurashtra follows as a plain sans whose capitals barely rise above the lowercase, so a long passage moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-sc: Redux spreads its letters wide and tips each round shape with a visible entry stroke, faint nib pressure in every bowl. Raise the Noto Sans SC size a touch.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Noto Sans Sharada brings sturdy, bulky lowercase to the text. Under Redux's widely spaced, geometric display letters, whose weight shifts are present but never dramatic, a long passage feels open and unhurried, its c forms never closing into rings.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Redux has arches that thin slightly as they leave the stem, plus a visible hook into every curve. And Noto Sans Siddham settles beneath it with a large central band and an s whose ends hang loose, friendly and contemporary.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Mellow, widely tracked geometry, with Redux entering each curve in a big visible swoop. Noto Sans Sinhala lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase in a plain sans, so give it a little extra size.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo reads as a plain sans with a sizable x-height, and its curved letters keep wide, unclosed mouths. Under Redux, a long passage runs easily.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Moderate stroke swelling gives Redux its geometric, widely spaced personality, with a big entrance into each curve. And Noto Sans Sundanese carries a long passage in a sans-serif with e crossbars that stay open and caps nearly level with the lowercase.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Approachable and clean, Redux spreads wide letters with thin strokes only slightly lighter than the thick ones, while Noto Sans Sunuwar is a sans with curves that leave daylight. Its strongest quality is friendliness.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nag: Soft modulation like hand-drawn ink gives Redux its character, with wide spacing and swooping entries into each curve. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri does the quieter work, a sans-serif with short ascenders, tall x-height and an a whose lower bowl opens to breathe.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac reads as a sans with tall, bulb-like bowls. Redux sits above in wide-set geometric display letters, its thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones, and the s shapes below turn wide and easy.
